title: Beautiful News is back for another year
content:
We’re a few weeks into a reboot of our Beautiful News project from a few years ago. Refreshed. Revitalised. Re-visualised.

Once more, every day for a year, we are surfacing and visualising some of the amazing, progressive and positive things happening around the world. Trends and events and innovations we can’t always see when fixated on the negativity of the news.

We’ve spruced and updated some of data-visualisations from the original collection, as well as adding 160 more stories to be released over the next weeks, months, year and beyond!

Every graphic is of course underpinned by open datasets to support full evidence-based optimism.

Swing by and join our weekly newsletter or daily on the website, or social channels of your choosing: Instagram, Twitter/X, Facebook, Threads.

Some of my favourite graphics and stories so far

» 34 Countries Now Generate 80% or More of Their Electricity from Renewables
» Tons of new vaccines are in the pipeline
» Polio is very nearly wiped out
» The Cost of Renewable Energy is Plunging
» The EU Gender Pay Gap is (slowly) Decreasing
» Everyone, Everywhere, is Living Longer

Towards a more nutritious information diet…

David
author: David McCandless
